paper.title_en: Novel concepts for RICH fast-timing electronics in view of the LHCb LS3 enhancement program$^{\star, \star\star}$
paper.abstract_en: A new ASIC, the FastRICH, has been designed to be the core of the next-generation readout of the LHCb Ring Imaging Cherenkov (RICH) detectors within the LS3 Enhancements and Upgrade II programs. These upgrades aim to introduce precise time-tagging capabilities for Cherenkov photons, resulting in enhanced background rejection in high-luminosity environments and improved particle identification performance. The FastRICH ASIC is designed to operate in the single-photon regime, providing high-resolution timing information together with flexible and event-driven readout. A prototype readout chain, based on lpGBT and VTRX+ optical chipset from CERN, is being developed to validate the system architecture and its integration within the LHCb readout framework, in preparation for future deployment in the upgraded RICH detectors.
